PR-2806 (TASK-2053 S3) round 1 at c3a2dcccf0: CHANGES REQUESTED (STRICT tier, containment). Full findings: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-joe-ai-aida/7d71bfbf-a609-42bd-a714-a7d52d81db81/scratchpad/briefs/pr-2806-r1-findings.txt
The S3 core is sound and CI is green. Fix these in a NEW commit (no force-push; merge origin/main first if behind):
1. [MAJOR] probe read confinement: seat_clone::probe_sandbox_args uses '--ro-bind / /'. The probe must not read more than the seat itself may: reuse the seat's own bwrap read view (bwrap_confinement_args_inner / [contained] read_allowlist) and bind only the clone plus the minimum git needs. Add a test with a narrowed read_allowlist proving a host path outside it is unreadable from the probe.
2. [MAJOR] reap data safety: reap_one_clone -> seat_clone::destroy goes straight to remove_dir_all on a possibly stale process_exited. Recheck liveness at execution time under the same lock (mirror teardown_worktree_path's WorktreeInUse refusal, BUG-1947) and refuse when in use. Test: a live process inside the clone makes reap refuse.
3. [MINOR] orphan-pin race: create writes refs/aida/seats/<dir> before the clone dir and lease exist, and orphan_pins releases 'no lease + no dir'. Write the lease (or an in-progress marker) before the pin, or make orphan detection ignore pins younger than a grace period / holding a create lock. Test the race.
4. [MINOR] explicit --path clones: refuse --path for clone seats, or make destroy handle that location. Never create a clone that destroy can't remove.
5. [MINOR] cap the captured sandboxed stdout and the salvage size (truncate, then say so).
6. [COSMETIC] run the cheap liveness and spec_finished gates before the probe in scan_clone_lease.
Gates: make check-ci-fast plus make test-touched. Push, wait for green CI, then 'aida mailbox send --to advisor --subject "READY: #2806 at <sha>"'.
